$description: Shokunin Crafthouse · Semantic tokens · purpose-mapped aliases · Light + Dark modes. Every $value is a DTCG reference to a primitive — no hex or px lives in this file. The default $value resolves to the LIGHT mode value; the DARK mode value lives in $extensions.modes.dark. Build tools that don't understand the modes extension still get a valid light-mode token tree.

$metadata.modeStrategy: Each token's $value is the light-mode resolution. $extensions.modes.{light,dark} holds the full per-mode map so any DTCG processor can pick the right alias per theme. Mode-invariant tokens (spacing) repeat the same alias in both modes — explicit, no implicit fallback.
$metadata.aliasRule: Semantic tokens MUST alias primitives via the {group.subgroup.name} DTCG reference syntax. Hardcoded hex / px values in this file are a bug and will fail Sprint 1 success criterion 1b.
